SESSION	CREATE OR REPLACE TEMPORARY VIEW testData AS SELECT * FROM VALUES
READ	SELECT a FROM testData ORDER BY a
READ	SELECT a FROM testData GROUP BY a, b ORDER BY a
READ	SELECT b FROM testData WHERE a > 1 ORDER BY a
READ	SELECT b FROM testData GROUP BY a, b ORDER BY a
READ	SELECT col1 FROM VALUES (1, named_struct('f1', 1)) ORDER BY col2.f1
READ	SELECT col1 FROM VALUES (1, named_struct('f1', named_struct('f2', 1))) ORDER BY col2.f1.f2
READ	SELECT a, (SELECT b FROM testData GROUP BY b HAVING b > 1 ORDER BY a) FROM testData
READ	SELECT a, (SELECT b FROM VALUES (1, 2) AS innerTestData (all, b) ORDER BY ALL) FROM testData
READ	SELECT * FROM testData ORDER BY (SELECT a FROM testData ORDER BY b)
READ	SELECT * FROM testData ORDER BY (SELECT * FROM testData ORDER BY (SELECT a FROM testData ORDER BY b))
READ	SELECT * FROM testData ORDER BY (SELECT a FROM VALUES (1))
READ	SELECT col1 FROM VALUES (1, 2) GROUP BY col1 ORDER BY MAX(col2), RAND()
READ	SELECT 1 AS col1, col1 FROM VALUES (10) ORDER BY col1
READ	SELECT 'a' ORDER BY CAST('a' AS VARIANT)
READ	SELECT a, b FROM testData ORDER BY CAST(a + b AS VARIANT)
READ	SELECT a FROM testData ORDER BY CAST(CAST(a AS VARIANT) AS VARIANT)
READ	SELECT a FROM testData GROUP BY a ORDER BY CAST(CAST(a AS STRING) AS VARIANT)
READ	SELECT * FROM testData ORDER BY CAST(null AS VARIANT)
READ	SELECT a FROM testData ORDER BY ARRAY(CAST(true AS VARIANT))
READ	SELECT a FROM testData ORDER BY CAST(ARRAY('a') AS VARIANT)
READ	SELECT a FROM testData ORDER BY CAST(ARRAY(CAST(true AS VARIANT)) AS VARIANT)
READ	SELECT SUM(a) + 1 FROM testData ORDER BY SUM(a) + 1
READ	SELECT 1 + SUM(b) FROM testData ORDER BY SUM(b) + 1
READ	SELECT SUM(a) + 1 FROM testData ORDER BY 1 + SUM(a)
READ	SELECT MAX(a) + SUM(b) FROM testData ORDER BY SUM(b) + MAX(a)
READ	SELECT SUM(a) + 1 + MIN(a) FROM testData ORDER BY 1 + 1 + 1 + MIN(a) + 1 + SUM(a)
READ	SELECT SUM(b) + 1 FROM testData HAVING SUM(b) + 1 > 0 ORDER BY SUM(b) + 1
READ	SELECT col1 FROM VALUES(1,2) GROUP BY col1, col2 ORDER BY col2, col2
READ	SELECT col1 AS a, a AS b FROM VALUES(1,2) GROUP BY col1, col2 ORDER BY col2, col2
READ	SELECT col1, col1 AS a FROM VALUES(1) GROUP BY col1 ORDER BY col1 ASC
READ	SELECT col1 AS a, col1 FROM VALUES(1) GROUP BY col1 ORDER BY col1 ASC
READ	SELECT make_date(col1, col2, col3) AS a, a AS b FROM VALUES(1,2,3) GROUP BY make_date(col1, col2, col3) ORDER BY make_da
READ	SELECT 1 AS a, 1 / a AS b, ZEROIFNULL(SUM(col1)) FROM VALUES(1) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY ZEROIFNULL(SUM(col1))
READ	SELECT col1 AS a, SUM(col2) AS b, CASE WHEN col1 = 1 THEN 1 END AS c FROM VALUES(1,2) GROUP BY col1 ORDER BY CASE WHEN c
READ	SELECT col1+1 AS ltrl2, col1+1 AS ltrl1 FROM VALUES(1) GROUP BY col1+1 ORDER BY col1+1
SESSION	DROP VIEW IF EXISTS testData
